    • forFullField

      public String forFullField()
      Description copied from class: DataFieldKeyGenerator
      Generates a key for the entire (full) field. That means that the key is essentially the same as the tag in the given representation (HUMAN, MIXED, MARC), with an additional "_full" suffix.
      Specified by:
      forFullField in class DataFieldKeyGenerator
